## Overview

GM-facing document capturing world naming, geography, climate, historical eras, and settlement pattern decisions.

---

## Design Rationale

Aetris (evokes ancient + triad theme). Kythoria (solid fantasy name). Geography supports core tension: recovered vs. contested territory. Three climate zones with capitals at center keep action focused on reconquering.

## Key Decisions

### Capital Cities
- Skywatch (The Lookout): Elevated, scouting, air genasi affinity
- Emberforge (The Forge): Underground volcanic, industrial
- Weaveheart (The Nexus): Ley line convergence, arcane research

### Climate & Regions
Frozen North (monster stronghold) -> Temperate Heartlands (capitals) -> Subtropical South (recovered). Eastern Coast (trade). Western Frontier (active war).

### Historical Eras
- Era of Foundation: before 400 ya (open for later)
- The Abominable End: 400-200 ya (defined suffering)
- The Rise of the Mortals: 200 ya-present (reconquering)

### Timeline
- ~400 ya: Invasion begins
- ~200 ya: Last Stand founded, three capitals established, barrier created
- Present: South/east recovered; north/west contested (~1/3 unrecovered)
- First Alliance: Formed AFTER capitals established, as army of the Last Stand. Defeated 3 of 5 Monster Generals.

---

## Implications
Three-era structure gives clear history. North/south divide drives exploration. Young civilization (~200 years) explains fluid politics. 70%+ knowledge loss creates natural dungeons.

## Open Questions
Era of Foundation details, settlement naming, map digitization.
